en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Serbia–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on dividends where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Serbia–Czech Republic treaty provides a general 10 per cent source-State ceiling on interest where the recipient is the beneficial owner, with a source-State exemption for the qualifying public-body category specified in Article 11. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Serbia–Czech Republic treaty provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling for copyright royalties relating to literary, artistic or scientific works other than computer programs, including films and broadcast media, and a 10 per cent ceiling for patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, computer programs, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment and know-how, where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
